scope: Agent file delivery, confirmed links, cards, open menu and preview
build: npm run build passed in the source workspace and the isolated source/lockfile copy. npm rebuild --ignore-scripts restored shared dependency command links.

frontend.artifact_checks: 8 artifact tests passed in the final rerun, including confirmed links, previews, native open/reveal dispatch, scope revocation, version changes and ambiguous paths.

failure_areas: unoffered tool calls in model fixtures
broader_suite.note: This record does not claim that the entire Agent suite passes. Native browser/Windows tests were not repeated during focused verification.

checks: Markdown link opens actual stored bytes
SVG thumbnail visible and opens image preview
browser.fixture: Synthetic UI acceptance files; no user financial workbook was processed. Native open/reveal dispatch is covered by mocks, not a live default-application launch.

delivery: Source implemented and local preview provided. Installed desktop package not replaced.

failure_conditions: A transient artifact-list failure stopped delivery until manual refresh.
A background command required a subsequent model process read before its files were registered.
An existing-file reference could disappear when a later answer stopped naming it.
Files above the preview limit were omitted from command manifests.
fixes: Retry read failures with backoff; keep polling pending file commands after the model turn ends.
Publish completed command manifests independently and persist them in encrypted task history.
Remember delivered references across later replies and compaction.
List oversized files with explicit preview limitations; native open and reveal remain available.
Refresh on artifact revisions, page focus and stale-version preview errors; ignore cancelled old-task requests.
stability_followup.background_result: 20/20 delivered without a model process-read tool call; stable file id and current bytes, then recovered through a new runtime/process registry.
stability_followup.transient_result: 10/10 recovered automatically from an injected initial HTTP 503.
stability_followup.browser: Preview backend returned HTTP 503; the new component recovered to three visible file cards without a manual file refresh.
stability_followup.bounds: Tests establish the scenarios recorded here, not universal success for every model/provider, prolonged outage or interruption during unfinished work. Installed desktop package has not been replaced.
stability_followup.locked_file_test: A permission/occupancy fault preserves the output card; automatic recheck makes the same file id openable after the lock is released.
stability_followup.publication_failure_test: A simulated task-state publication failure recovers through collection and never replays the already-confirmed command.
stability_followup.build: Final source workspace production build passed.
